module: "Project Settings" window (projectSettings) of the Flowgraph editor. It edits the metadata of the current project: name, description (512 chars max), authors, difficulty (0-100, label Easy/Medium/Hard/Very Hard in steps of 25) and "Is Scenario" checkbox. Also displays the file name and the save folder, with Save and Save as... buttons (.flow.json extension).
notes: Each change of name, author, difficulty or scenario mode adds a history entry via fgEditor.addHistory.
In debug mode (preference flowgraph.debug.editorDebug) the window displays an icon if the project is hidden (mgr.hidden) or transient (mgr.transient, cannot be saved).
The description is modified without a history entry.
The difficulty label uses floor(value/25)+1: the value 100 falls back to 'Very Hard' thanks to the fallback, otherwise 0-24 Easy, 25-49 Medium, 50-74 Hard, 75-99 Very Hard.

attach.desc: Stores the manager and prepares the ImGui fields (name 64 chars, authors 128 chars, difficulty pointer) from mgr.name, mgr.authors and mgr.difficulty.

init.desc: Registers the window in the editor (150x300, hidden by default).

draw.desc: Draws the project fields and the Save / Save as... buttons. Save calls fgEditor.save(), Save as opens the file dialog then fgEditor.saveAsFile.

_onSerialize.desc: Window serialization hook: empty, nothing is saved.
